acceptance_criteria.criterion: [Declaration, local-ci/2] lib/local_ci_contract.py accepts schema local-ci/2: the local-ci/1 fields plus a required workspace object with exactly bootstrap, dependencies and outputs; each bootstrap entry one of the three allowlisted forms; dependencies and outputs unique, normalized, repository-relative literals that never equal, contain or lie inside another; local-ci/1 unchanged.

[Declaration, observed at the head] The observer reads .ai/ci/local-ci.json from the workspace/head tree, validates it with the pinned lib, and refuses a declared dependency or output tracked at the head, containing a tracked path, or not ignored by the head, each as gate_workspace_declaration_invalid:<reason>. local-ci/1 or no contract declares nothing (ACH-S-07 strict).

[Bootstrap, network and credential policy] Bootstrap commands run in order and before the gates, argv with shell=False and stdin closed, with GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, npm_config_userconfig=/dev/null and a private npm_config_cache; non-zero refuses gate_workspace_bootstrap_failed:<command> with no gate run; tracked files stay at the head and only declared dependencies may gain untracked paths.

[Outputs] Untracked paths are allowed only under dependencies and outputs; tracked paths stay checked after every gate; a declaration never relaxes the observed-root checks. An undeclared output refuses gate_workspace_undeclared_output:<path>.

[Provenance] Every certify-v2 and merge-v2 derivation writes one gate-workspace/1 record (head and tree, local-ci.json sha256 and schema, each bootstrap command with executable path, version, exit and duration, pinned source sha256s, streaming digests of each dependency path, outputs present after the gates, network: bootstrap, workspace path); the results and driver log carry its path and sha256.

[Compatibility] A repository with local-ci/1 or no contract behaves exactly as after ACH-S-07, skills' own .ai/ci/local-ci.json stays local-ci/1, and the listed tests pass unmodified. The one re-pin authorized by the AC1 vs AC6 reconciliation (tests/readiness_v2_gate_shadowing_test.py) is recorded below.

[Documentation, consumers] modules/ci-gate.md documents local-ci/2 with the ai-catapult and ai-factory consumer shapes; modules/readiness-v2.md and ADR 0017 add the declaration, the network and credential policy, the provenance record and the codes gate_workspace_declaration_invalid and gate_workspace_bootstrap_failed; the new tests assert each is documented.

[Evidence] The PR body records a scratch run of the bootstrap and the gate commands of ai-catapult a87c912 and ai-factory 69ed795 under the bootstrap and gate environments, with the untracked paths each creates. Planning baseline (2026-10-04): ai-catapult `bash setup.sh` then npm test, 248 of 248 pass, creating only vendor/, dist/ and dist-snapshot/; ai-factory `npm ci --ignore-scripts` then npm test (237 of 237 with the umbrella reachable), lint and typecheck, creating only node_modules/. This is supporting evidence, not a CI test, because it needs the network.
